joint_cover.message: The problem is infeasible. (HiGHS Status 8: model_status is Infeasible; primal_status is None)

scope: Finite floating-point pool only. Includes all sampled frozen zero-profile conics, six new A2 profiles and the old4329 bank, with native offset corrections in all new-new products. Degree>=3 is necessary for every actual polygon facet of a compact H3, but insufficient. No exact or all-continuous nonexistence claim. Numerical affine exclusions are not complete; any surviving proposal still requires exact cusp screening and geometry.
